The booth needs a 10ft x 10ft footprint at its best — most catering halls we work in across Astoria, Flushing and Forest Hills have that to spare — and we can compress to 8ft x 8ft when a Jamaica or Ridgewood venue is tighter. A standard 110V outlet within 15 feet is the only other requirement, and setup takes about 20 minutes once we arrive an hour ahead of your start time.

Your cover is designed with you before the event — names, date, colors and cover lines, or a full brand lockup for corporate work — and a trained attendant runs unlimited sessions for your full booking. Covers print on site and also deliver digitally by text, email or QR code, with an online gallery afterward. Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees, quoted from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqHeading: Magazine Photo Booth in Queens — FAQ

faqs.q: Is the magazine booth good for a large Queens wedding?
faqs.a: Yes. Unlimited sessions mean it holds up at a 300-guest catering hall reception just as well as a smaller event, and the oversized cover frame keeps the corner visually interesting even when a line has formed.

faqs.q: Can we design a Sweet Sixteen cover for a Queens event?
faqs.a: Yes — it is one of our most-requested designs in Flushing and Forest Hills. Send us the guest of honor's name, colors and any theme, and our design team builds the cover before the event.

faqs.q: How much space does the magazine booth need?
faqs.a: Optimal setup is 10ft x 10ft, which most Queens catering halls have to spare. We compress to 8ft x 8ft for tighter venues, and we need a standard 110V outlet within 15 feet.

faqs.q: Do you charge a travel fee in Queens?
faqs.a: Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees. We quote it from your venue ZIP code before you book.
About 20 minutes once we arrive. We arrive a full hour before your start time so everything is tested and ready before your first guest sees it.

faqs.q: Do guests get a printed and digital cover?
faqs.a: Both. Covers print on site from a dye-sublimation printer, and every guest also gets the digital version by text, email or QR code.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for a Queens venue?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $3 million liability insurance policy. If your venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.

faqs.q: How much does a magazine booth rental cost in Queens?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on how many hours you need and your specific venue, rather than a flat rate card. The quote form returns a real number in about 30 seconds, and additional hours beyond your booked time are $125 per hour.
